content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选集镇厂并按设计规模降序取第一名。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "统计设备台账中类型为鼓风机的总数及状态为备用的数量。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%'", "explanation": "按名称模糊匹配南郑中心污水处理厂，查询其设计处理规模字段。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站，列出名称、类型和设计规模。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按额定功率降序取前 10 台设备，列出厂站、编码、类型、型号和状态。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量和额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码、类型和状态。"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3_d, count(*) AS 厂站数 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计规模求和并统计厂站数量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取中心厂（P01）最新一条实时采集记录的进水瞬时流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查协税镇污水站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的MLSS值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取各厂站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的两个好氧区溶解氧值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 2) AS 电流_A FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查 P01-BL-1 鼓风机最近 30 分钟内最新一条监测记录的运行电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天（前一自然日）所有厂站的小时处理水量，得到全区总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整点小时数据，累加 blower_kw（小时均值即该小时耗电量 kWh）得到总耗电量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取各厂最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的出水总氮，按厂站列出，可看出当前最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总本周（从周一开始至今）plant_reading_1h 的小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选名称含“中心”的厂站，统计今天0点至12点小时表进水COD均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(daily_m3)::numeric, 1) AS 日均处理水量_m3 FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS d, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS daily_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1) x", "explanation": "筛选梁山镇污水站10月30日至11月4日（6个自然日）的小时数据，按天汇总处理水量后求日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD均值, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选名称含“中心”的厂站，统计昨天整日小时均值表中出水 COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站统计过去24小时 plant_reading_1h 中进水氨氮的小时均值平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天全天所有厂站的小时鼓风机功率之和（即耗电量）与处理水量之和，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())", "explanation": "汇总本周所有厂站小时表中的碳源与PAC投加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天（前一自然日）气象数据中的最高和最低气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "污泥浓度 MLSS 只在分钟级表 plant_reading 中，按厂站统计过去7天平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整日的小时均值数据，对曝气风量 air_flow_m3h 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂本周鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按小时汇总今天全区各厂站的处理水量（inflow_m3h 之和）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按小时聚合表筛选协税镇11月3日全天，取每小时出水总磷均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂碳源投加总量与处理水量之比，即吨水碳源投加量，并按从高到低排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂出水COD小时均值，按平均值降序取最高厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天分组统计 11 月 1 日至 4 日气象数据的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "统计昨天各厂站小时处理水量之和，按水量降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取最高的一条，返回厂站、时间和COD值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按天汇总最近7天全区处理水量并降序取最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "按本周汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水电耗并升序取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计过去7天各厂出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的小时数，列出超标厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站11月4日全天的小时数据，统计出水氨氮最大值超过5mg/L的小时数并取当日最高值。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 总磷超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（周一起）所有厂站小时均值中出水总磷最大值超过0.5 mg/L 的小时记录总数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮平均_毫克每升, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮最大小时均值_毫克每升 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "筛选中心厂最近7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值和最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷_mg_L FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选协税镇本周小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过0.5的记录，按时间升序取第一条即为本周首次超标时刻。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(h.hour) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以厂站为主表左连接昨天的小时数据，按一级A标准统计各厂出水超标的小时数，无超标厂显示0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(count(*)::numeric, 0) AS 停机分钟数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND r.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND r.running = false", "explanation": "统计黄官镇1号鼓风机11月4日全天 running=false 的分钟记录数，即停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, p.name AS 厂站, round(max(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY d.code, p.name ORDER BY max(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各鼓风机振动最大值，按降序取第一台即为振动最大的鼓风机。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_℃ FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.running AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂鼓风机设备，统计过去24小时运行状态下的平均轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 1) AS 平均电流_A FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵，统计昨天运行时的平均电流，按设备分组。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND r.running = true AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, d.code ORDER BY p.id, d.code", "explanation": "筛选污泥泵设备，统计昨天 running=true 的分钟级记录条数即为运行分钟数，按厂站和设备分组。"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选10月31日全天气象数据，取降雨强度最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND r.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY r.ts LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇（P06）1号鼓风机11月4日振动超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条即首次超标时间。"}

{"sql": "SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间, max(ts) AS 结束时间, count(*) AS 降雨小时数, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 累计降雨量_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "筛选10月31日全天降雨强度大于0的记录，取最早和最晚时间作为降雨起止时间，并统计降雨小时数与累计雨量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(min(r.do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 最低溶解氧_mg_L, round(min(r.do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 2) AS 最低溶解氧2_mg_L FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND r.ts < timestamptz '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08'", "explanation": "查黄官镇厂11月4日15-18点原始分钟级数据中好氧区溶解氧的最小值。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= date '2026-10-30' AND h.hour < date '2026-11-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT (SELECT 水量 FROM d WHERE 日期 = date '2026-10-31') AS 暴雨当天水量_m3, (SELECT 水量 FROM d WHERE 日期 = date '2026-10-30') AS 前一天水量_m3, (SELECT 水量 FROM d WHERE 日期 = date '2026-10-31') - (SELECT 水量 FROM d WHERE 日期 = date '2026-10-30') AS 增加水量_m3", "explanation": "按日汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日与31日的处理水量并求差值"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, sum(rain_mm_h) AS 降雨量 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 降雨量 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT d.日期 AS 降雨最大日期, round(d.降雨量::numeric, 1) AS 降雨量_mm, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 全区处理水量_m3 FROM d JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date = d.日期 GROUP BY d.日期, d.降雨量", "explanation": "先按日汇总最近7天降雨量取最大的一天，再汇总该日全区处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高出水总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选协税镇厂站11月3日全天的小时数据，取出水总磷小时最大值的最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站统计过去7天进出水总氮均值，用1减去出水/进水比值计算总氮去除率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂')::numeric, 0) AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric * 100, 2) AS 中心厂占比_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "统计最近7天全区与中心厂的处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)），并计算中心厂占比。"}

{"sql": "WITH avg7 AS (SELECT h.plant_id, avg(h.cod_in) AS cod_avg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY h.plant_id), overall AS (SELECT avg(h.cod_in) AS cod_all FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days') SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(a.cod_avg::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD, round(o.cod_all::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM avg7 a JOIN plant p ON p.id = a.plant_id CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.cod_avg > o.cod_all ORDER BY a.cod_avg DESC", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天平均进水COD，并与全区7天平均进水COD比较，筛选高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1) SELECT round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 前日处理水量_m3, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN 水量 END) - max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 增加量_m3 FROM d", "explanation": "按自然日汇总全区处理水量，取昨天与前天两日水量并计算差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计昨天各厂小时处理水量之和，除以设计日处理规模得到负荷率百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "统计 device 表中类型为鼓风机的设备总数及状态为备用的数量。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, code AS 厂站编码, kind AS 厂站类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, kind AS 厂站类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_立方米每日 FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选集镇厂并按设计规模降序取第一名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按额定功率降序查询设备台账并关联厂站名称，取功率最大的前 10 台设备。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量与额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率, d.status AS 当前状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON d.plant_id = p.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码、类型等信息。"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3d, count(*) AS 厂站数量 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计处理规模求和并统计厂站数量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 2) AS 进水流量_立方米每小时, r.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查中心厂最新一条实时数据的进水瞬时流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(pr.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧, round(pr.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧, pr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, do_aerobic_1, do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading WHERE plant_id = p.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON true ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "对每个厂站取 plant_reading 中最新一条记录，读取好氧区 1、2 号溶解氧当前值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(pr.mlss::numeric, 1) AS 污泥浓度MLSS, pr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant_reading pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' ORDER BY pr.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站名匹配协税镇，取 plant_reading 最新一条记录的 MLSS 值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, r.ts AS 采集时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 2) AS 电流A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, current_a, running FROM device_reading WHERE device_id = d.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.code = 'P01-BL-1' LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按设备编码 P01-BL-1 定位中心厂 1 号鼓风机，取该设备最新一条监测记录的电流值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(pr.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮 FROM plant_reading pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM plant_reading) ORDER BY pr.tn_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取最新时刻各厂出水总氮，按降序取最高的一厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天全天所有厂站的小时处理水量得到全区总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整点小时数据，累加 blower_kw（数值等于该小时耗电量 kWh）得到总耗电量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 本周处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 本周处理水量_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按本周起始时间过滤小时均值表，按厂站汇总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(daily_m3)::numeric, 1) AS 日均处理水量_m3 FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS d, sum(inflow_m3h) AS daily_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1) t", "explanation": "按天汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日至11月4日的处理水量，再取日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(cod_in)::numeric, 2) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours'", "explanation": "筛选中心厂今天0点至12点的小时均值，对进水COD求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD均值, round(avg(r.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整天的1小时均值数据，对出水COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷分别求日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name", "explanation": "取最近24小时小时均值表，按厂站求进水氨氮平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round((sum(blower_kw) / nullif(sum(inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天全天所有厂站的小时鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之和，相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天（前一自然日）气象数据中的最高和最低气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now()", "explanation": "汇总本周（本周一至今）所有厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均污泥浓度_mgL DESC", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天 plant_reading_1h 中 MLSS 的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.hour) AS 时间, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', r.hour) ORDER BY 时间", "explanation": "按协税镇厂筛选11月3日全天，从小时聚合表按小时分组求出水总磷均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT hour AS 时间, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour", "explanation": "按今天各整点汇总所有厂站小时处理水量"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整日的小时均值数据，对曝气风量取平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.ts < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均污泥浓度_mgL DESC", "explanation": "plant_reading_1h 无 mlss 字段，改查原始表 plant_reading 按厂站统计最近7天 MLSS 平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01' AND ts < '2026-11-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按自然日分组统计气象表 11月1日至4日的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按昨天自然日汇总各厂站小时处理水量并取前三名"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均出水COD DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂出水COD小时均值，按平均值降序取最高者。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date ORDER BY 日期", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂本周鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 6) AS 吨水碳源投加量 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量 DESC NULLS LAST", "explanation": "按厂站汇总最近7天碳源投加量(kg)与处理水量(m³)，相除得吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.hour AS 时间, round(r.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取第一条，关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按自然日汇总最近7天（不含今天）各厂站小时处理水量，取水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS water, sum(r.blower_kw) AS kwh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.id, p.name) SELECT name AS 厂站, round(water::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量m3, round(kwh::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量kWh, round((kwh / NULLIF(water, 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水电耗kWh每m3 FROM t WHERE water > 0 ORDER BY 吨水电耗kWh每m3 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "按本周（date_trunc('week', now()) 至今）汇总各厂处理水量与鼓风机耗电量，计算吨水电耗并升序取最低两厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now() AND tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（周一起至今）所有厂站小时记录中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准0.5 mg/L的小时数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.hour >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND r.nh3n_out_max > 5", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇11月4日全天小时数据，统计出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的小时数及最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最大出水氨氮, min(h.hour) AS 首次超标时间, max(h.hour) AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 超标小时数 DESC", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂站小时均值表中出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的记录，按超标小时数排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水总氮, round(max(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值总氮 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂最近7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值和最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "WITH hours AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, h.hour, h.cod_out, h.nh3n_out_max, h.tn_out, h.tp_out_max, h.ss_out FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())) SELECT name AS 厂站名称, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cod_out > 50 OR nh3n_out_max > 5 OR tn_out > 15 OR tp_out_max > 0.5 OR ss_out > 10) AS 超标小时数 FROM hours GROUP BY id, name ORDER BY id", "explanation": "取昨天各厂小时数据，按一级A标准逐小时判断五项出水指标是否超标并计数，用 LEFT JOIN 保证无数据/无超标的厂也列出（计 0）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, min(r.hour) AS 首次总磷超标时间, round(max(r.tp_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最大总磷值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() AND r.tp_out_max > 0.5 GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选协税镇本周小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准0.5 mg/L的最早时间点。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, round(max(dr.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动值 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.model ORDER BY 最大振动值 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "近7天鼓风机设备振动数据按设备取最大值，排序取振动最大的一台。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 设备型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY p.code, d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(count(*)::numeric, 0) AS 停机分钟数 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.running = false AND dr.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND dr.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "统计黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机在11月4日全天 running=false 的分钟级记录条数，即停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 平均温度_摄氏度, round(max(r.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 最高温度_摄氏度, count(*) AS 数据点数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading r ON r.device_id = d.id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' AND r.running = true AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂状态为运行的鼓风机，关联最近24小时运行监测数据，按设备统计平均与最高轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流A FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading r ON r.device_id = d.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running = true AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵，统计昨天运行状态下的平均运行电流。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS d0, date_trunc('day', now()) AS d1) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(count(*)::numeric, 0) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id CROSS JOIN t WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND dr.running = true AND dr.ts >= t.d0 AND dr.ts < t.d1 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选污泥泵设备，统计昨天（前一自然日）内 running=true 的分钟级记录条数，即各厂污泥泵运行分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT dr.ts AS 时间, round(dr.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动速度_mms FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND dr.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND dr.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY dr.ts ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）在11月4日全天振动值大于7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条即首次超标时间。"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_毫米每小时 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "查询10月31日全天气象数据中降雨强度的最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS 开始时间, to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS 结束时间, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 累计降雨量 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "筛选10月31日全天降雨强度大于0的记录，取最早和最晚时刻作为降雨起止时间，并累计降雨量。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS day, sum(inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND hour < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round((SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08')::numeric, 1) AS \"10月31日处理水量\", round((SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08')::numeric, 1) AS \"10月30日处理水量\", round(((SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08') - (SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'))::numeric, 1) AS \"增加水量\"", "explanation": "按日汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日与31日的处理水量并求差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(min(do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧最低值, round(min(do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧最低值 FROM plant_reading pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND pr.ts >= '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND pr.ts < '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08'", "explanation": "按原始数据查黄官镇污水厂 11月4日 15:00-18:00 好氧区 1、2 号溶解氧的最小值。"}

{"sql": "WITH daily_rain AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS d, sum(rain_mm_h) AS rain FROM weather WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rain DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT to_char(dr.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, round(dr.rain::numeric, 1) AS 降雨量mm, round(sum(pr.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量m3 FROM daily_rain dr JOIN plant_reading_1h pr ON pr.hour >= dr.d AND pr.hour < dr.d + interval '1 day' GROUP BY dr.d, dr.rain", "explanation": "先按天汇总最近7天降雨量取最大的一天，再汇总该日全区各厂站小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选协税镇厂 11 月 3 日全天的小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日出水总磷最高值。"}

{"sql": "WITH p7 AS (SELECT plant_id, avg(cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY plant_id) SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(p7.avg_cod::numeric, 2) AS 近7天平均进水COD FROM p7 JOIN plant p ON p.id = p7.plant_id WHERE p7.avg_cod > (SELECT avg(cod_in) FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days') ORDER BY p7.avg_cod DESC", "explanation": "按厂站统计近7天平均进水COD，并与全区整体平均进水COD比较，筛选高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) AS today) SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < d.today THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < d.today - interval '1 day' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS 前日处理水量, round((sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < d.today THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < d.today - interval '1 day' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 1) AS 增加量 FROM plant_reading_1h r CROSS JOIN d WHERE r.hour >= d.today - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < d.today", "explanation": "用小时聚合表分别汇总昨天与前天全区各厂站处理水量并求差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - sum(r.tn_out * r.inflow_m3h) / NULLIF(sum(r.tn_in * r.inflow_m3h), 0)) * 100, 2) AS 总氮去除率百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总最近7天进出水总氮的流量加权总量，计算总氮去除率百分比。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT round((sum(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(sum(vol), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 中心厂处理水量占比百分比, round(sum(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS 中心厂处理水量立方米, round(sum(vol)::numeric, 1) AS 全区处理水量立方米 FROM t", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂站处理水量，按中心厂/集镇厂汇总后计算中心厂占全区百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d, round((sum(r.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站汇总昨天全天小时处理水量，除以设计规模得到负荷率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(((1 - sum(r.tn_out * r.inflow_m3h) / NULLIF(sum(r.tn_in * r.inflow_m3h), 0)) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮去除率百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总最近7天进出水总氮的流量加权总量，计算总氮去除率百分比，并将结果转为 numeric 后保留两位小数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按额定功率降序取前 10 台设备，列出厂站、编码、类型、型号、功率和状态。"}
{"sql": "SELECT d.kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(d.rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device d GROUP BY d.kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量和额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出编码、类型等信息。"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查中心厂最近30分钟内最新一条实时进水流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取各厂站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的两个好氧区溶解氧值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查协税镇污水站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的MLSS值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查 P01-BL-1 鼓风机最近 30 分钟内的最新一条监测记录，取电流值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取各厂最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的出水总氮，按厂站列出（可看出最高值）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天全天所有厂站的小时处理水量得到全区总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整点小时数据，累加 blower_kw（小时均值即该小时耗电量 kWh）得到总耗电量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总本周（从周一开始至今）plant_reading_1h 的 inflow_m3h 得到处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(daily)::numeric, 1) AS 平均日处理水量_m3 FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS d, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS daily FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1) x", "explanation": "按天汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日至11月4日的处理水量，再取日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂今天0点至12点的1小时均值数据，对进水COD求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近24小时 plant_reading_1h 中进水氨氮的小时均值平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD均值, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整日的小时均值数据，分别对出水COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷求日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "从气象表筛选昨天全天记录，取气温最大值和最小值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天全天所有厂站的小时鼓风机功率之和作为耗电量，并除以同期处理水量得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())", "explanation": "汇总本周（周一起）所有厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "从实时表 plant_reading 取过去7天各厂 MLSS 平均值，按厂站分组。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按小时汇总今天全区各厂站的处理水量（inflow_m3h 之和）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整日的小时均值数据，对曝气风量 air_flow_m3h 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按协税镇厂站筛选11月3日全天，从小时聚合表取每小时出水总磷均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂本周鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天对气象表气温取平均，筛选11月1日至4日（不含5日）"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天 plant_reading_1h 中出水COD的小时均值，取平均后降序取最高者。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "统计昨天各厂站小时处理水量之和，按水量降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂碳源投加总量与处理水量之比，即吨水碳源投加量，并按从高到低排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按天汇总全区各厂站小时处理水量，取过去7天中水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值中按出水COD降序取第一条，得到最高值对应的厂站、时间和数值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "按本周汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水电耗并升序取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的小时数，并列出最高值。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 总磷超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（周一起）所有厂站小时均值中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时记录数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站11月4日全天的小时数据，统计出水氨氮最大值超过5mg/L的小时数并取当日最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮平均_mgL, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮最大小时均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂最近7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值和最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以厂站为主表左连接昨天的小时数据，按一级A标准统计各厂出水不达标的小时数，无超标记录的厂显示 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷_mg_L FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选协税镇本周小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过0.5的记录，按时间升序取第一条即为首次超标时刻。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(max(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY 最大振动_mm_s DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各鼓风机振动最大值，按降序取第一台即为振动最大的鼓风机。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS d0), r AS (SELECT dr.ts, dr.running FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id, t WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= t.d0 AND dr.ts < t.d0 + interval '1 day') SELECT round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT running) * 1.0)::numeric, 0) AS 停机分钟数, count(*) AS 数据条数 FROM r", "explanation": "取昨天（11月4日）黄官镇 P06-BL-1 鼓风机的分钟级监测数据，统计 running=false 的条数即为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_摄氏度 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.running AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂鼓风机、运行状态且最近24小时的监测数据，按设备编码统计平均轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 1) AS 平均电流_A FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵，统计昨天运行状态下的平均电流，按设备编码分组。"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选10月31日全天气象数据，取降雨强度最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND r.running = true AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, d.code ORDER BY p.id, d.code", "explanation": "筛选污泥泵设备，统计昨天 running=true 的分钟级记录条数即运行分钟数，按厂站和设备分组。"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND r.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY r.ts LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站（P06）1号鼓风机在11月4日全天振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间, max(ts) AS 结束时间, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 累计降雨量_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "筛选10月31日全天降雨强度大于0的记录，取最早与最晚时间作为降雨起止时间，并累计降雨量。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= date '2026-10-30' AND h.hour < date '2026-11-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT max(CASE WHEN 日期 = date '2026-10-31' THEN 水量 END) AS 暴雨当天水量_m3, max(CASE WHEN 日期 = date '2026-10-30' THEN 水量 END) AS 前一天水量_m3, max(CASE WHEN 日期 = date '2026-10-31' THEN 水量 END) - max(CASE WHEN 日期 = date '2026-10-30' THEN 水量 END) AS 增加水量_m3 FROM d", "explanation": "按日汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日与31日的处理水量并求差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(min(r.do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 最低溶解氧_mg_L, round(avg(r.do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 平均溶解氧_mg_L FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND r.ts < '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08'", "explanation": "按原始分钟级数据筛选黄官镇厂 11 月 4 日 15:00–18:00 时段，取好氧区溶解氧的最小值与均值。"}

{"sql": "WITH max_rain_day AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS d FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(rain_mm_h) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT m.d AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h CROSS JOIN max_rain_day m WHERE h.hour >= m.d AND h.hour < m.d + interval '1 day' GROUP BY m.d", "explanation": "先按日汇总最近7天降雨量找出降雨最大的一天，再统计该日全区所有厂站的处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高出水总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选协税镇厂站11月3日全天的小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日出水总磷最高值。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1) SELECT round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 昨天处理水量_m3, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 前天处理水量_m3, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN 水量 END) - max(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 增加量_m3 FROM d", "explanation": "按自然日汇总昨天与前天的全区处理水量并求差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH p7 AS (SELECT h.plant_id, avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY h.plant_id), allavg AS (SELECT avg(cod_in) AS region_avg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days') SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(p7.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD, round((SELECT region_avg FROM allavg)::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均COD FROM p7 JOIN plant p ON p.id = p7.plant_id WHERE p7.avg_cod > (SELECT region_avg FROM allavg) ORDER BY p7.avg_cod DESC", "explanation": "统计近7天各厂进水COD均值，并与全区整体均值比较，筛出高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂')::numeric, 0) AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric * 100, 2) AS 中心厂占比_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "统计最近7天全区与中心厂（kind='中心厂'）的处理水量并计算占比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站统计过去7天出水总氮均值与进水总氮均值，用1减比值计算总氮去除率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 工艺, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY p.process", "explanation": "按工艺分组统计昨天（前一自然日）各小时处理水量之和。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率, d.status AS 当前状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON d.plant_id = p.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码、类型等信息。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量和额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 1) AS 额定功率千瓦, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按额定功率降序排列设备台账，取前 10 台并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(pr.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_立方米每小时, pr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant_reading pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' ORDER BY pr.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查中心厂最新一条实时数据的进水瞬时流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(pr.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧, round(pr.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧, pr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, do_aerobic_1, do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading WHERE plant_id = p.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON true ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "取每个厂站最新一条实时数据中的好氧区溶解氧数值"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(pr.mlss::numeric, 1) AS 污泥浓度MLSS, pr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant_reading pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' ORDER BY pr.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查协税镇污水站最新一条实时数据的 MLSS 值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, r.ts AS 采集时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 2) AS 电流A FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, current_a FROM device_reading WHERE device_id = d.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.code = 'P01-BL-1'", "explanation": "按设备编码 P01-BL-1 定位中心厂 1 号鼓风机，取该设备最新一条监测记录的电流值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(pr.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮, pr.hour AS 时间 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour = (SELECT max(hour) FROM plant_reading_1h) ORDER BY pr.tn_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10", "explanation": "取最新小时各厂出水总氮均值，按降序排列，最高者即为当前出水总氮最高的厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 昨日处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天全天所有厂站小时处理水量（inflow_m3h 之和）得到全区昨日总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整点小时数据，累加 blower_kw（小时均值即该小时耗电量 kWh）得到总耗电量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按本周起始时间过滤小时聚合表，按厂站汇总进水流量得到处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(cod_in)::numeric, 2) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours'", "explanation": "筛选中心厂今天0点至12点的小时均值，对进水COD求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(daily_m3)::numeric, 1) AS 日均处理水量_m3 FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS d, sum(inflow_m3h) AS daily_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1) t", "explanation": "按天汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日至11月4日的处理水量，再取日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD均值, round(avg(r.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整日的小时均值数据，对出水 COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷分别求日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name", "explanation": "取最近24小时小时均值表，按厂站求进水氨氮平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(pr.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round((sum(pr.blower_kw) / NULLIF(sum(pr.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3, round(sum(pr.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h pr WHERE pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天全天所有厂站小时表的鼓风机功率（即耗电量）与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now()", "explanation": "汇总本周（本周一至今）所有厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量，小时均值即该小时投加公斤数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "取昨天自然日范围内气象数据的最高和最低气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均污泥浓度_mgL DESC", "explanation": "从小时聚合表取最近7天各厂 MLSS 均值并按厂站分组。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(pr.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整点小时数据，对曝气风量 air_flow_m3h 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.hour) AS 时间, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', r.hour) ORDER BY 时间", "explanation": "筛选协税镇污水站 11 月 3 日全天的小时数据，按整点分组计算出水总磷均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS 时间, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour", "explanation": "按小时汇总今天全区各厂站处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)），时间转为本地时区显示。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01' AND ts < '2026-11-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天分组统计气象表 11 月 1 日至 4 日的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(blower_kw) / nullif(sum(inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY date_trunc('day', hour)::date ORDER BY 日期", "explanation": "按天汇总本周中心厂的小时鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均出水COD DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂出水COD小时均值，按平均值降序取最高者。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 6) AS 吨水碳源投加量 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量 DESC NULLS LAST", "explanation": "按厂站汇总最近7天碳源投加量（kg）与处理水量（m³），相除得到吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按昨天自然日汇总各厂站小时处理水量并取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.hour AS 时间, round(r.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取第一条，得到最高值对应的厂站、时间和数值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND hour < now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按天汇总最近7天各厂站小时处理水量，取水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮, min(h.hour) AS 首次超标时间, max(h.hour) AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 超标小时数 DESC", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂小时均值表中出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站及超标情况。"}

{"sql": "WITH w AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', now()) AS ws), agg AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS water, sum(r.blower_kw) AS kwh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id, w WHERE r.hour >= w.ws AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.id, p.name) SELECT name AS 厂站, round(water::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量m3, round(kwh::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量kWh, round((kwh / NULLIF(water, 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水电耗kWh每m3 FROM agg WHERE water > 0 ORDER BY 吨水电耗kWh每m3 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "按本周（date_trunc('week', now()) 起）汇总各厂处理水量与鼓风机耗电量，计算吨水电耗并取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND pr.hour >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND pr.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND pr.nh3n_out_max > 5", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇厂11月4日全天的小时数据，统计出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5mg/L的小时数及最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now() AND tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（周一起至今）所有厂站小时记录中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准0.5 mg/L的小时数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 超标时间, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最大值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选协税镇本周内小时出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准0.5 mg/L的最早一条记录。"}

{"sql": "WITH hours AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, h.hour, h.cod_out, h.nh3n_out_max, h.tn_out, h.tp_out_max, h.ss_out FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())) SELECT name AS 厂站名称, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cod_out > 50 OR nh3n_out_max > 5 OR tn_out > 15 OR tp_out_max > 0.5 OR ss_out > 10) AS 超标小时数 FROM hours GROUP BY id, name ORDER BY id", "explanation": "取昨天各厂小时数据，按一级A标准逐小时判断出水是否超标并计数，无超标厂显示0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水总氮, round(max(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值总氮 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('hour', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂最近7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值与最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, round(max(dr.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动值 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.model ORDER BY 最大振动值 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "近7天鼓风机设备振动监测数据按设备取最大值，排序取振动最大的一台。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY p.code, d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT dr.ts, dr.running, lag(dr.running) OVER (ORDER BY dr.ts) AS prev_running FROM device_reading dr JOIN device dev ON dev.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = dev.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND dev.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND dr.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08') SELECT round(count(*)::numeric, 0) AS 停机分钟数 FROM d WHERE running = false", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机11月4日全天每分钟运行状态，统计 running=false 的记录数即为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, round(avg(dr.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 平均温度_摄氏度, round(max(dr.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 最高温度_摄氏度, count(dr.ts) AS 采样点数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.model ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂状态为运行的鼓风机，关联过去24小时设备监测数据，按设备统计平均与最高轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(dr.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流A FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND dr.running = true AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵，统计昨天运行状态下的平均运行电流，按设备分组。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS d0, date_trunc('day', now()) AS d1) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(count(*)::numeric, 0) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id CROSS JOIN t WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND dr.running = true AND dr.ts >= t.d0 AND dr.ts < t.d1 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选污泥泵设备，统计昨天（前一自然日）内 running=true 的分钟级记录条数作为运行分钟数，按厂站分组。"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm每小时 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "查询气象表 10 月 31 日全天降雨强度的最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT dr.ts AS 时间, round(dr.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动值 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND dr.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AND dr.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY dr.ts ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）在11月4日全天振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨开始时间, to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨结束时间, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 累计降雨量毫米 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "筛选10月31日全天降雨强度大于0的气象记录，取最早与最晚时间作为降雨起止时间，并累计降雨量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(min(pr.do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 最低溶解氧, round(min(pr.do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 2) AS 最低溶解氧2 FROM plant_reading pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND pr.ts >= '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND pr.ts < '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08'", "explanation": "按原始分钟级数据筛选黄官镇厂 11月4日15-18点，取好氧区1号（及2号）溶解氧最小值。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS day, sum(inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND hour < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round((SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08')::numeric, 1) AS \"10月31日处理水量\", round((SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08')::numeric, 1) AS \"10月30日处理水量\", round(((SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08') - (SELECT vol FROM d WHERE day = '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'))::numeric, 1) AS \"增加水量\"", "explanation": "按日汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日与31日的处理水量并求差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH rain AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS d, sum(rain_mm_h) AS rain_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rain_mm DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT to_char(r.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, round(r.rain_mm::numeric, 1) AS 降雨量毫米, round(sum(p.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量立方米 FROM rain r JOIN plant_reading_1h p ON date_trunc('day', p.hour) = r.d GROUP BY r.d, r.rain_mm", "explanation": "先按日汇总最近7天降雨量取最大的一天，再汇总该日全区各厂站小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND pr.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选协税镇厂 11 月 3 日全天的小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日出水总磷最高值。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) AS today) SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < d.today THEN r.inflow_m3h END)::numeric, 1) AS 昨天处理水量, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < d.today - interval '1 day' THEN r.inflow_m3h END)::numeric, 1) AS 前天处理水量, round((sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < d.today THEN r.inflow_m3h END) - sum(CASE WHEN r.hour >= d.today - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < d.today - interval '1 day' THEN r.inflow_m3h END))::numeric, 1) AS 增加水量 FROM plant_reading_1h r CROSS JOIN d", "explanation": "按自然日汇总全区各厂站小时处理水量，对比昨天与前天的总量差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - sum(r.tn_out * r.inflow_m3h) / NULLIF(sum(r.tn_in * r.inflow_m3h), 0)) * 100, 2) AS 总氮去除率百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总近7天进出水总氮的流量加权总量，计算总氮去除率百分比。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT round((sum(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(sum(vol), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 中心厂处理水量占比百分比, round(sum(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0) AS 中心厂处理水量m3, round(sum(vol)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量m3 FROM t", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂站处理水量，按中心厂/集镇厂汇总后计算中心厂占全区百分比。"}

{"sql": "WITH p7 AS (SELECT plant_id, avg(cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY plant_id), region AS (SELECT avg(cod_in) AS region_avg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days') SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, round(p7.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 过去7天平均进水COD, round(r.region_avg::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM p7 JOIN plant p ON p.id = p7.plant_id CROSS JOIN region r WHERE p7.avg_cod > r.region_avg ORDER BY p7.avg_cod DESC", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天小时表进水COD均值，与全区同期均值比较，筛出高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量m3, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模m3d, round((sum(r.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按昨天自然日汇总各厂小时处理水量，除以设计规模得到负荷率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 工艺, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY p.process", "explanation": "按工艺分组统计昨天各小时处理水量之和，A2O 与氧化沟分别汇总。"}
